d:
Here's another Raeza set from me, this time actually straight sex stuff. I gotta say, I enjoyed making this set a lot, in part due to the scene file itself not tanking my framerate too much. I also tried a picture-in-picture concept for the first time here (the third sequence, pages 33 to 40) and I feel it contributed a lot to perceived dynamics of the action (I know it's not ideal but I still like it). I hope people will like this set as much as I did working on it.
